periods.analysis: Q1 actions: Held cooking demonstrations at two library branches and handed out nutrition tip sheets at WIC visits, reaching 160 residents. Partners: Parks/Rec/Libraries, Harborview Community Health Center.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Add sessions at school family nights and design a sugary-drink awareness campaign.

periods.analysis: Q2 actions: Ran nutrition sessions at spring family nights in three schools, and attendance reached 245. Drafted a sugary-drink awareness campaign with student input. Partners: Harborview Unified School District, Parks/Rec/Libraries, Harborview Community Health Center.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Launch the sugary-drink campaign at back-to-school, continue library demonstrations, and fold nutrition lessons into Family Home Visiting.

periods.analysis: Q3 actions: Ran a back-to-school sugary-drink awareness campaign and taught cooking demonstrations at three library branches and two school family nights. Nutrition lessons were bundled into existing Family Home Visiting visits. Partners: Harborview Unified School District, Parks/Rec/Libraries, Harborview Community Health Center.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Adapt the recipes for pantry staples and offer them at food distributions.
